The '''Insect Head''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be obtained as a [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication]] reward for killing 80 cave insects. After this, another Insect Head can be purchased from [[Marlon]] for {{Price|10000}}.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Level lowered from 6 to 4 and sell price lowered from {{Price|300}} to {{Price|200}}.}}
{{History|1.6|Raised damage from 10-20 to 20-30. Level raised from 4 to 6 and sell price raised from {{Price|200}} to {{Price|300}}. Now earned after killing 80 Cave Insects, down from 125.}}
